item.title: Cities alter the latitudinal diversity gradient of birds in North America
item.content:encoded:
Nature Cities, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44284-026-00529-6

Urbanization considerably modifies the latitudinal diversity gradient of birds in North America, with native species exhibiting a flatter gradient in cities compared to surrounding areas, particularly during winter, highlighting complex interactions between human impacts and environmental factors.
